heading: INT. ORBITAL HYDROPONICS BAY, STATION KESTREL - CONTINUOUS

units.text: INT. ORBITAL HYDROPONICS BAY, STATION KESTREL - CONTINUOUS
Racks of lettuce under violet light.
Pipes sweat.
A hum like a slow pulse.
The floor is a grid, the ceiling a curve.
COMMANDER INGRID SORENSEN-AKINTOLA (50s, gray crop, crisp jumpsuit) walks the aisle with a tablet.
Behind her trails botanist FELIX OYELARAN-DUBOIS (30s, goggles pushed up, hands green to the wrist).
At a bench, engineer MARISOL TRAN (30s, ponytail, wrench in hand) tightens a valve.
In the far corner, a robot technician, UNIT FOUR (a squat maintenance drone with a cheerful chirp), polishes a lens.
The newest arrival is medic CASIMIR OKONKWO-BLYTHE (40s, trim beard), who leans in the hatchway.
Status report, everyone. Now.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Lettuce is thriving.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Valve's holding.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Beep. All systems nominal.
units.name: UNIT FOUR

units.text: Medically, I'm bored.
units.name: CASIMIR

units.text: That's what I like to hear.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: A low metallic thud echoes from the water tank behind the racks.
All five turn.
That's not supposed to happen.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: Of course it is.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Ingrid raises a hand.
Silence.
Another thud, closer.
The lights dim a fraction.
Unit Four chirps and rolls backward.
Felix, Marisol, check the tank. Casimir, with me.
units.name: INGRID

units.text: ^Yes, Commander.
units.name: FELIX

units.text: ^Yes, Commander.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: They reply in unison and split.
Felix and Marisol creep toward the tank.
Ingrid and Casimir circle the racks opposite, tablet and medkit held like weapons.
Behind the tank, a fat grey cat, ORION, sits atop a coil of hose, licking one paw.
It meows.
Everyone stops.
Felix laughs first, a startled bark.
Marisol sags against the rack.
Ingrid pinches the bridge of her nose.
Who smuggled a cat onto my station?
units.name: INGRID

units.text: Unit Four rolls up and nuzzles the cat's head with a mechanical arm.
Beep. New crew member detected.
units.name: UNIT FOUR
